flow_summary: The interviewer consistently recovers the confused patient's vague or muddled answers by rephrasing, breaking questions into smaller parts, and clarifying scales, which keeps the intake on track. Safety disclosure is handled with an immediate, proportionate response followed by continuation. Minor issues include a few verbatim repeats of PHQ/GAD items when the patient says they lost the thread, and one slightly abrupt transition after the safety message.

issues.evidence: PHQ-9 Q3 repeated verbatim three times with only the scale re-added on the fifth turn.
Safety message followed immediately by “What do you hope to get out of your appointment?” without a brief pause or check-in.
